detail.headline: Supercharge your developers and AI agents.

detail.subhead: Big tasks go better in small steps. Give each step a fresh harness that holds only what that step needs: nothing drifts, and smaller models can do more of the work.

detail.positioning: Harness and agent optimized operation, in plain words: a harness is the program that runs your coding agent, such as Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode. Today your agent can search Baltor's reviewed library at each step and download only what that step needs, with its source, licence and exact version. The fresh harness for each step is being built.

detail.split: Free to install. Paid access to the library, one plan at 29 United States dollars each month. Your model keys stay with you, and Baltor never asks you for a provider key.
